patterns: APPSC asks single-fact location items: highest peak of a continent (Kilimanjaro, Kosciuszko), where a desert lies (Sonoran, Great Victoria), what Sierra Nevada is.
Ordering items: continents by area and largest countries (APPSC G1 descending order Russia, Canada, USA, China); India 7th.
South America map facts recur: Pacific coastline countries (not Venezuela), landlocked Bolivia/Paraguay, Andes countries, Tropic of Capricorn.
APPSC G1 also asks harder regional-physiography names (Tsaidam basin, Yukon plateau, Karakoram between Pamir and Indus).
App MCQs favour multi-statement and plateau-type classification items; PYQs are simpler and broader (continent superlatives, desert-country pairs).
